tools.name: choose_program
tools.description: Runs the three-question FHA multifamily program chooser from fhamultifamily.loan/chooser: returns the likely program (223(f), 221(d)(4) new construction or substantial rehab, 223(a)(7), 241(a), or "not FHA yet"), the reason, and the program page to read next.

tools.name: size_loan
tools.description: Estimates the maximum FHA 223(f) or 221(d)(4) loan the way HUD Form 92264-A does, with the fhamultifamily.loan sizer: statutory limit (2026 per-unit limits x high-cost %), loan to value or cost, debt service coverage with 0.25% MIP, the 223(f) cash-out or acquisition test, large-loan ratios at $130M

tools.name: get_limits_and_costs
tools.description: HUD's 2026 FHA multifamily rulebook as the site publishes it: per-unit statutory limits by bedroom (Section 207/223(f)/220, 221(d)(4) or 231; elevator and non-elevator) with the high-cost amount for a state, loan-to-value and coverage ratios by tier, large-loan ratios, MIP, HUD fees and loan terms,
